entries.title: Evening Briefing · 16 November 2026
headlines: Wall Street slides as tech sells off before Nvidia's results
Ukraine launches its largest drone attack on Russia of the war
Trump to meet Putin and Xi together at APEC in China this week
Immigration and Asylum Bill faces final Commons stages on Tuesday
Indian shares rebound while Wall Street and London slip

stories.headline: FTSE 100 edges lower as miners and US tech weigh
stories.summary: London fell 21 points to 10,881.55 (−0.19%) as miners slipped on weak Chinese data and US chip stocks hit sentiment.
stories.whyItMatters: The index is still near record levels, but the global tech wobble is reaching UK trading.

stories.headline: Sensex and Nifty bounce on bank and FMCG buying
stories.summary: Sensex closed at 82,102.85 (+0.63%) and Nifty at 25,291.10 (+0.58%), while midcaps and smallcaps fell.
stories.whyItMatters: Foreign investors have bought a net $8.9bn of Indian shares so far in November, the most in any month since 2002.

stories.headline: US stocks fall, led by chipmakers
stories.summary: At midday ET the Nasdaq was down about 1.7% and the S&P 500 about 1.1%, with Nvidia, AMD and Intel all lower.
stories.whyItMatters: Nvidia reports on Tuesday, a big test of investor appetite for AI stocks.

stories.headline: Ukraine's biggest drone strike on Russia; Kerch bridge hit
stories.summary: Russia reported the largest overnight Ukrainian drone attack of the war, including over Moscow and Crimea. The Kremlin is assessing minor damage to the Crimean bridge.
stories.whyItMatters: The strikes come as peace talks stall and Russia repeats its demand that NATO pull back.

stories.headline: Trump–Putin–Xi meeting planned at APEC
stories.summary: The White House says Trump will hold a joint meeting with Putin and Xi at APEC in China this week.
stories.whyItMatters: A first meeting of all three could shape arms control and the Iran war. Reports differ on the exact day.

stories.headline: Iran–Gulf tensions: Bahrain intercepts drones; mass life sentences
stories.summary: Bahrain says it intercepted several Iranian aerial threats, and a Bahraini court gave life sentences to scores of defendants accused of plotting with Iran.
stories.whyItMatters: The fighting is spreading to Gulf states that host US forces, adding risk to oil and shipping.

stories.headline: UK and allies press Israel on Gaza aid access
stories.summary: The UK, Australia, Canada and Italy called for unimpeded humanitarian access to Gaza as floods worsen conditions.
stories.whyItMatters: Western pressure over aid is growing while strikes continue.

stories.headline: Estonia to shut all Russian border crossings from 1 December
stories.summary: Estonia accuses Russian military intelligence of ordering an attempted arson attack on a drone maker near Tallinn.
stories.whyItMatters: It is the latest escalation in suspected Russian sabotage on NATO's eastern flank.

stories.headline: COP31 under way in Antalya; Guterres urges deep emissions cuts
stories.summary: The UN chief called for immediate, drastic cuts to fossil-fuel emissions, and Canada pledged up to $392.5m to a tropical forest fund.
stories.whyItMatters: Negotiators must show progress on finance and fossil-fuel phase-down before the talks end.

stories.headline: Visitor Levy Bill debated in the Commons tonight
stories.summary: The bill would let English mayors charge for overnight stays. The Lib Dems and Reform UK want to block it because it sets no cap.
stories.whyItMatters: It could add a tourist tax to hotel bills in English cities.

stories.headline: Busy week in Westminster: immigration bill, PMQs, UK–EU summit
stories.summary: The Immigration and Asylum Bill has its final Commons stages on Tuesday, and the second UK–EU summit is in Brussels on Friday.
stories.whyItMatters: Tuesday's votes and Friday's summit will shape migration law and post-Brexit trade.

stories.headline: EC tells Supreme Court restored SIR voters won't be prosecuted
stories.summary: Voters removed in the Special Intensive Revision who reapply with Form 6 will not face prosecution, the Election Commission said.
stories.whyItMatters: The voter-roll revision is a major political fight over alleged wrongful deletions.

stories.headline: Supreme Court moves Red Fort blast cases to Delhi; suspends two Bilkis Bano life sentences
stories.summary: The court allowed the NIA to move cases linked to the 2025 Red Fort blast to Delhi, and suspended the life sentences of two Bilkis Bano convicts.
stories.whyItMatters: Moving the cases puts the terror investigation in one place; the Bilkis Bano order is likely to draw strong reactions.

stories.headline: BJP and Congress clash over Rahul Gandhi's "vote chor" remark
stories.summary: The BJP attacked Rahul Gandhi over the remark and filed a complaint with the FRRO.
stories.whyItMatters: The row ties into the wider dispute over the SIR voter rolls.

stories.headline: No new Immigration Rules today
stories.summary: No new Immigration Rules, Statement of Changes or fee changes were published on 16 November. The latest is still HC 584 (3 September 2026).

stories.headline: Earned settlement (ILR): announced, not yet in the rules
stories.summary: Settlement would become 10 years by default, with 5-year routes for earnings of £50,271+ or key public-service jobs and 3 years for £125,141+.
stories.whyItMatters: Rules are due to start being laid from December, with no effective dates confirmed yet.

stories.headline: Immigration and Asylum Bill: Commons Report Stage and Third Reading on Tuesday
stories.summary: MPs take the bill's final Commons stages on Tuesday.
stories.whyItMatters: If it passes, the bill goes to the Lords; watch amendments on settlement or appeals.

stories.headline: India win the ODI series in New Zealand 3–1
stories.summary: India, captained by stand-in Shreyas Iyer, won the series 3–1, while Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli had a lean tour.
stories.whyItMatters: A strong away result, with questions about the senior batters before the 2027 ODI World Cup.

stories.headline: ICC publishes men's calendar to 2035
stories.summary: India will host the 2029 Champions Trophy and co-host the 2031 ODI World Cup with Bangladesh.

stories.headline: England win 3–2 in Spain to top their Nations League group
stories.summary: Kane, Konsa and White scored in Madrid despite a red card, ending Spain's 43-match unbeaten run.

stories.headline: Gaganyaan G1 uncrewed flight: launch campaign under way
stories.summary: ISRO has started assembling the human-rated LVM3 at Sriharikota. No launch date is confirmed.
stories.whyItMatters: It is the key test before ISRO flies astronauts.

stories.headline: ISRO's GSLV-F18 puts NVS-03 navigation satellite in orbit
stories.summary: The launch adds a satellite to India's NavIC regional navigation constellation.

entries.title: Morning Briefing · 16 November 2026
headlines: Nvidia shock hits Asian chip stocks
Immigration and Asylum Bill returns to the Commons
Modi in Manila for the ASEAN Summit
India take ODI series in New Zealand; England win in Madrid

stories.headline: Iran strikes at Bahrain again as peace talks stall
stories.summary: Iran launched a drone attack on Bahrain on Sunday, ending a roughly two-month lull.
stories.whyItMatters: Renewed Gulf fighting feeds straight into oil prices and UK inflation.

stories.headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two tankers struck mines and caught fire, and that one sank. There is no independent confirmation.
stories.whyItMatters: About a fifth of seaborne oil passes through the strait.

stories.headline: Houthi drones and missiles fired at Saudi cities
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition says it shot down drones over Mecca and Medina and two missiles aimed at Riyadh. The Houthis dispute its account.
stories.whyItMatters: Strikes near the holy cities widen the conflict.

stories.headline: Estonia to shut all Russia border crossings from 1 December
stories.summary: Estonia will close the crossings after what it calls a failed sabotage attempt on a defence firm.
stories.whyItMatters: Europe is hardening its response to Russian hybrid activity.

stories.headline: Busy week at Westminster: immigration bill, PMQs and a UK–EU summit
stories.summary: The Visitor Levy Bill is debated today, the Immigration and Asylum Bill returns on Tuesday, and the UK–EU summit is on Friday.
stories.whyItMatters: Tuesday's vote is the bill's last Commons hurdle before the Lords.

stories.headline: UK joins allies urging Israel to let winter shelter into Gaza
stories.summary: The UK, Australia, Canada and Italy called on Israel to allow 150,000 tents into Gaza now.
stories.whyItMatters: It adds diplomatic pressure on Israel over aid access.

stories.headline: Edinburgh protest against planned AI data centres
stories.summary: Thousands marched in Edinburgh against plans for large AI data centres in Scotland.
stories.whyItMatters: Power and water concerns are a growing obstacle to AI growth zones.

stories.headline: PM Modi at the ASEAN Summit in Manila, 16–18 Nov
stories.summary: Modi is at the 49th ASEAN Summit, with trade and maritime security on the agenda.
stories.whyItMatters: India is deepening ties in Southeast Asia while maritime tensions with China stay unresolved.

stories.headline: Election Commission eases voter-roll revision for movers
stories.summary: Voters who missed the enumeration forms can now submit them from where they currently live.
stories.whyItMatters: It answers part of the concern that migrant workers could be dropped from the rolls.

stories.headline: Inflation above the RBI's band raises rate-hike talk
stories.summary: October retail inflation came in at 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% upper limit.
stories.whyItMatters: A rate hike would raise EMIs and borrowing costs.

stories.headline: No new Immigration Rules this week
stories.summary: No new Immigration Rules were laid in the past week. The latest Statement of Changes is still HC 584 (3 Sep 2026).

stories.headline: Earned settlement: 10-year default route to ILR
stories.summary: Settlement becomes 10 years by default, 5 years above £50,271 or in public-service roles, and 3 years at £125,141. Rules are expected from December 2026.
stories.whyItMatters: There is no general exemption for people already in the UK, so the rules in force when you apply decide your route.

stories.headline: B2 English requirement expected from 26 March 2027
stories.summary: A law firm reports that the higher B2 English level is due for applications from 26 March 2027.
stories.whyItMatters: Anyone applying for an extension or ILR in 2027 should check which level applies on their date.

stories.headline: India win ODI series in New Zealand 3–1
stories.summary: India took the series under stand-in captain Shreyas Iyer.
stories.whyItMatters: Top-order form is a worry heading towards the 2027 ODI World Cup.

stories.headline: England beat Spain 3–2 in Madrid
stories.summary: England won despite a red card, ending Spain's 43-match unbeaten run and topping their Nations League group.

stories.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on Wednesday
stories.summary: NASA says the probe crosses one light-day, about 26 billion km, at 10:16 GMT on 18 Nov.
stories.whyItMatters: It is the first human-made object to get that far.

stories.headline: ULA Vulcan loses 40 Amazon Leo satellites
stories.summary: A Vulcan rocket failed shortly after lift-off and did not put 40 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit.
stories.whyItMatters: It sets back Amazon's race with Starlink and may ground Vulcan.

stories.headline: FTSE 100 at a three-month high on a defensive rotation
stories.summary: Money moved out of AI-linked stocks into energy, healthcare and utilities on Friday.

stories.headline: India: Sensex and Nifty up as money rotates out of Asian tech
stories.summary: Indian shares rose while Taiwan, the Kospi and the Nikkei fell. Foreign investors have bought over $8bn of Indian shares this month.
